_comment_excludes: Optional. Glob patterns excluded even when their extension matches FileExtensions. Patterns containing '/' match against the relative path from SourceFolder (e.g. 'build/*'); patterns without '/' match against the leaf filename only (e.g. 'Thumbs.db' or '*.bak'). Wildcards: * (any chars) and ? (single char). Case-insensitive.
_comment: SourceFolder, StorageAccount and SasToken belong in .env (see .env.example). The fields below are optional fallbacks used only if .env is missing the corresponding key.
